en.title: ENCOUNTER · ALPHA 0.3
en.note: Production catalog: 550 cards · 30-card starter decks · 30 HP · five paths. Overview pauses this encounter. Reopening restarts it with the same seed at the safe battle checkpoint. Card names and rules text currently use the German production catalog.
